data.title: 椎名真昼 · 抱枕旁的读书便签
data.description: 傍晚客厅里，真昼穿奶油色麻花毛衣和浅蓝家居长裤，盘腿坐在沙发上。她把白熊抱枕搁在膝间，认真将一张叶形书签夹进读到一半的书，发现夹反后忍不住轻轻笑了。
data.action: 盘腿坐在抱枕旁，把夹反的叶形书签转正，轻轻一笑。
data.mood: 私人空间卸下防备、依赖感
data.promptProse: A leaf-shaped bookmark has slipped into the book upside down, and Mahiru Shiina smiles quietly at her own mistake. She sits cross-legged on the sofa in a cream cable-knit sweater and loose pale-blue lounge trousers, with a white bear cushion supporting the open paperback on her lap. A shaded floor lamp illuminates her amber eyes and flaxen hair without hiding the face in shadow. Show the seated pose, bookmark and cozy room together in a close horizontal composition, alone and without text.
